title: Dialog close button at phone width: the X in the shared Dialog is a 16x16 px target, below the 44 px minimum, in every modal the mobile app shows
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect with a named location, class b, an out-of-scope finding from #29070's phone run (Approvals flow, a child of #29040) · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** The mobile app 2.0 hosts the Console in a WebView (objectstack-ai/mobile#144), so every modal a phone user opens is the shared `Dialog`. Its close X is a 16×16 px tap target, well under the 44 px minimum that #29040 sets. Phone users miss the tap and fall back on a backdrop tap or Cancel, which some dialogs do not offer.

**Location.** `ui/packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx:56-57` at `origin/main`: `DialogPrimitive.Close` is `absolute right-4 top-4 rounded-sm` around `<X className="h-4 w-4" />`, with no padding or minimum size.

**reach:** measured in a real browser at 375×812 by #29070's os-dev, on the declared-action param dialog of a `sys_approval_request` record page (the Reject decision): the close button's box is 16×16 px.

**Wanted.**
1. The `Dialog` close button has a tap target of at least 44×44 px at phone width, without moving the visible icon or growing the desktop header.
2. Match the close-X size and mechanism that #29078 (Dashboards at phone width) lands for the `Sheet` close in `sheet.tsx`, so both primitives agree.
3. A test that pins the target size.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`, size S. It runs after #29078 lands if both touch the same shared size token or class; otherwise it can build beside it. #29070 and #29071 leave `dialog.tsx` alone.

**Dedupe.** Searched `dialog close touch target` (108 hits; the open ones are #29040, #29078 and unrelated cards), `dialog.tsx close` (1 hit: #5505, closed, about the sr-only label), and `close button 44` (62 hits, none about the Dialog close). #29078 covers `sheet.tsx` only.

Links back: #29040, #29070, #29078.
